        ob.data.materials.append(m)
    smooth(ob)
    return ob


def fan_section(name, centre, cowl_r, steel, grille_m, blade_m):
    cx, cy, cz = centre
    cyl(name + "_Cowl", cowl_r, 0.22, (cx, cy, cz + 0.11), m=steel, verts=40)
    cyl(name + "_Throat", cowl_r - 0.05, 0.24, (cx, cy, cz + 0.05), m=steel, verts=40)
    top = cz + 0.22

    for k in range(10):

        box(name + "_Spoke", (0.018, 2.0 * cowl_r * 0.94, 0.014),
            (cx, cy, top), rot=(0.0, 0.0, a), m=grille_m)
    cyl(name + "_GrilleHub", 0.075, 0.05, (cx, cy, top + 0.01), m=grille_m, verts=16)

    # fan and motor below the grille
    cyl(name + "_Hub", 0.10, 0.16, (cx, cy, cz - 0.02), m=steel, verts=20)

def louvre_panel(name, centre, width, rows, steel, louvre_m, face_y):

    box(name + "_Frame", (width + 0.10, 0.05, rows * 0.095 + 0.10),
        (cx, cy, cz), m=steel, bevel=0.006)
    for i in range(rows):

        box(name + "_Slat", (width, 0.085, 0.016),
            (cx, cy + face_y * 0.03, z),
            rot=(math.radians(32.0) * face_y, 0.0, 0.0), m=louvre_m)


def duct_run(name, y, steel):

    box(name + "_Drop", (h, w, z - h / 2.0 - 0.0),
        (x1 + h / 2.0, y, (z - h / 2.0) / 2.0), m=steel, bevel=0.01)
    # flanged joints

"""claude-071 - A picnic table with attached benches (A-frame, crossed legs)."""

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector


def reset():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'


def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (col[0], col[1], col[2], 1.0)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    return m


def smooth(ob, angle=40.0):
    for p in ob.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    es = ob.modifiers.new("EdgeSplit", 'EDGE_SPLIT')
    es.split_angle = math.radians(angle)


def box(name, dims, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, bevel=0.0):
    """Exact sized box; object scale stays 1.0 so bevel widths are uniform."""
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=Vector(dims), verts=bm.verts)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if m:
        me.materials.append(m)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bv = ob.modifiers.new("Bevel", 'BEVEL')
        bv.width = bevel
        bv.segments = 2
        bv.limit_method = 'ANGLE'
        bv.angle_limit = math.radians(40.0)
    return ob


def beam(name, p1, p2, w, d, m=None, bevel=0.0):
    """Board of cross section (w along X, d along Y) spanning p1->p2."""
    a, b = Vector(p1), Vector(p2)
    v = b - a
    ob = box(name, (w, d, v.length), tuple((a + b) * 0.5), m=m, bevel=bevel)
    ob.rotation_euler = v.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return ob


def cyl(name, r, h, loc, rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, verts=16):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=r, depth=h,
                                        location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob = bpy.context.object
    ob.name = name
    if m:
        ob.data.materials.append(m)
    smooth(ob)
    return ob


def camera(loc, target, lens=45.0):
    cd = bpy.data.cameras.new("Camera")
    cd.lens = lens
    cam = bpy.data.objects.new("Camera", cd)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(cam)
    cam.location = loc
    cam.rotation_euler = (Vector(target) - Vector(loc)).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    bpy.context.scene.camera = cam
    return cam


def sun(rot, energy, color=(1.0, 0.96, 0.9)):
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new("Sun", 'SUN')
    ld.energy = energy
    ld.angle = math.radians(2.0)
    ld.color = color
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new("Sun", ld)
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    return ob


def world(col, strength):
    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
    w.use_nodes = True
    bg = w.node_tree.nodes["Background"]
    bg.inputs[0].default_value = (col[0], col[1], col[2], 1.0)
    bg.inputs[1].default_value = strength
    bpy.context.scene.world = w


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ build
def build():
    reset()
    world((0.42, 0.56, 0.78), 1.1)

    wood_top = mat("WoodTop", (0.46, 0.29, 0.15), 0.62)
    wood_frm = mat("WoodFrame", (0.38, 0.23, 0.115), 0.72)
    steel = mat("Steel", (0.55, 0.56, 0.58), 0.32, 1.0)
    grass = mat("Grass", (0.19, 0.30, 0.11), 0.92)

    box("Ground", (26.0, 26.0, 0.2), (0.0, 0.0, -0.1), m=grass)

    TOP_Z = 0.75          # finished table height
    PT = 0.04             # top plank thickness
    PW = 0.145            # plank width
    GAP = 0.012
    LEN = 1.90            # table length along X
    BENCH_Z = 0.45
    BT = 0.035            # bench plank thickness
    FRAME_X = 0.62        # the two leg frames

    # --- table top planks -------------------------------------------------
    pitch = PW + GAP
    for i in range(5):
        y = (i - 2) * pitch
        box("TopPlank_%d" % i, (LEN, PW, PT), (0.0, y, TOP_Z - PT / 2.0),
            m=wood_top, bevel=0.006)

    # --- bench planks (two per side) -------------------------------------
    for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
        for i, off in enumerate((-0.0785, 0.0785)):
            y = s * 0.66 + off
            box("BenchPlank_%s%d" % ("L" if s < 0 else "R", i),
                (LEN, PW, BT), (0.0, y, BENCH_Z - BT / 2.0),
                m=wood_top, bevel=0.005)

    # --- leg frames -------------------------------------------------------
    top_beam_z = TOP_Z - PT - 0.03      # centre of the top cross member
    bench_beam_z = BENCH_Z - BT - 0.03  # centre of the bench cross member

    for sx in (-1.0, 1.0):
        x = sx * FRAME_X

        # crossed splayed legs
        beam("Leg_%s_A" % sx, (x, -0.90, 0.0), (x, 0.30, 0.72),
             0.09, 0.05, m=wood_frm, bevel=0.006)
        beam("Leg_%s_B" % sx, (x, 0.90, 0.0), (x, -0.30, 0.72),
             0.09, 0.05, m=wood_frm, bevel=0.006)

        # bench cross member and top cross member
        box("BenchBeam_%s" % sx, (0.085, 1.76, 0.06), (x, 0.0, bench_beam_z),
            m=wood_frm, bevel=0.006)
        box("TopBeam_%s" % sx, (0.085, 0.74, 0.06), (x, 0.0, top_beam_z),
            m=wood_frm, bevel=0.006)

        # diagonal braces: bench member outer ends up to the top frame
        for sy in (-1.0, 1.0):
            beam("Brace_%s_%s" % (sx, sy),
                 (x, sy * 0.80, bench_beam_z + 0.02),
                 (x, sy * 0.09, top_beam_z - 0.02),
                 0.06, 0.04, m=wood_frm, bevel=0.005)

        # bolt heads where the members meet the legs
        for (by, bz) in ((0.24, bench_beam_z), (-0.24, bench_beam_z),
                         (0.30, top_beam_z), (-0.30, top_beam_z),
                         (0.78, bench_beam_z), (-0.78, bench_beam_z)):
            cyl("Bolt", 0.014, 0.09, (x, by, bz), rot=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0),
                m=steel, verts=12)

    # longitudinal stringer tying the two frames together
    box("Stringer", (2 * FRAME_X + 0.17, 0.09, 0.05), (0.0, 0.0, top_beam_z - 0.055),
        m=wood_frm, bevel=0.005)

    # --- lighting and camera ---------------------------------------------
    sun((math.radians(52.0), 0.0, math.radians(38.0)), 4.0)

    ld = bpy.data.lights.new("Fill", 'AREA')
    ld.energy = 220.0
    ld.size = 4.0
    fill = bpy.data.objects.new("Fill", ld)
    fill.location = (-3.0, -3.5, 3.2)
    fill.rotation_euler = (Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.6)) - fill.location).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(fill)

    camera((3.1, -3.5, 2.15), (0.0, 0.0, 0.55), lens=45.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build()

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector


def reset():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'


def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):

    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal

def smooth(ob, angle=40.0):
    for p in ob.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    es = ob.modifiers.new("EdgeSplit", 'EDGE_SPLIT')
    es.split_angle = math.radians(angle)


def box(name, dims, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, bevel=0.0):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=Vector(dims), verts=bm.verts)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if m:
        me.materials.append(m)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bv = ob.modifiers.new("Bevel", 'BEVEL')
        bv.width = bevel
        bv.segments = 2
        bv.limit_method = 'ANGLE'
    return ob


def cyl(name, r, h, loc, rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, verts=20):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=r, depth=h,
                                        location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob = bpy.context.object
    ob.name = name
    if m:
        ob.data.materials.append(m)
    smooth(ob)
    return ob


def tube(name, p1, p2, r, m=None, verts=16):
    a, b = Vector(p1), Vector(p2)
    v = b - a
    ob = cyl(name, r, v.length, tuple((a + b) * 0.5), m=m, verts=verts)
    ob.rotation_euler = v.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return ob


# court constants (metres)
HALF_L = 11.885
DOUB = 5.485
SING = 4.115
SERV = 6.40
NET_HALF = 6.40
POST_H = 1.07
CENTRE_H = 0.914


def net_height(x):
    t = abs(x) / NET_HALF
    return CENTRE_H + (POST_H - CENTRE_H) * (t ** 2)


def build_net(mesh_mat, tape_mat):
    nx, nz = 72, 14
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("NetMesh")
    bm = bmesh.new()
    cols = []
    for i in range(nx + 1):
        x = -NET_HALF + 2.0 * NET_HALF * i / nx
        h = net_height(x) - 0.055          # under the tape
        cols.append([bm.verts.new((x, 0.0, h * j / nz)) for j in range(nz + 1)])
    for i in range(nx):
        for j in range(nz):
            bm.faces.new((cols[i][j], cols[i + 1][j], cols[i + 1][j + 1], cols[i][j + 1]))
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    net = bpy.data.objects.new("Net", me)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(net)
    me.materials.append(mesh_mat)
    wf = net.modifiers.new("Wireframe", 'WIREFRAME')
    wf.thickness = 0.008
    wf.use_replace = True
    wf.use_boundary = True

    # white tape band following the same sag
    me2 = bpy.data.meshes.new("TapeMesh")
    bm = bmesh.new()
    strip = []
    for i in range(nx + 1):
        x = -NET_HALF + 2.0 * NET_HALF * i / nx
        h = net_height(x)
        strip.append((bm.verts.new((x, 0.0, h)), bm.verts.new((x, 0.0, h - 0.06))))
    for i in range(nx):
        bm.faces.new((strip[i][0], strip[i + 1][0], strip[i + 1][1], strip[i][1]))
    bm.to_mesh(me2)
    bm.free()
    tape = bpy.data.objects.new("NetTape", me2)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(tape)
    me2.materials.append(tape_mat)
    so = tape.modifiers.new("Solidify", 'SOLIDIFY')
    so.thickness = 0.014
    so.offset = 0.0
    return net, tape


def fence_panel(name, w, h, cell, loc, rot, m, thick=0.012):
    nx = max(2, int(round(w / cell)))
    ny = max(2, int(round(h / cell)))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    vs = [[bm.verts.new((-w / 2.0 + w * i / nx, -h / 2.0 + h * j / ny, 0.0))
           for j in range(ny + 1)] for i in range(nx + 1)]
    for i in range(nx):
        for j in range(ny):
            bm.faces.new((vs[i][j], vs[i + 1][j], vs[i + 1][j + 1], vs[i][j + 1]))
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    me.materials.append(m)
    wf = ob.modifiers.new("Wireframe", 'WIREFRAME')
    wf.thickness = thick
    wf.use_replace = True
    return ob


def build():
    reset()
    w = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
    w.use_nodes = True
    bgn = w.node_tree.nodes["Background"]
    bgn.inputs[0].default_value = (0.44, 0.58, 0.82, 1.0)
    bgn.inputs[1].default_value = 1.3
    bpy.context.scene.world = w

    surround = mat("Surround", (0.13, 0.32, 0.26), 0.9)
    playarea = mat("PlayArea", (0.11, 0.30, 0.52), 0.85)
    white = mat("LinePaint", (0.94, 0.94, 0.92), 0.65)
    dark = mat("NetMesh", (0.04, 0.04, 0.05), 0.8)
    postm = mat("PostMetal", (0.10, 0.20, 0.16), 0.45, 0.7)
    fencem = mat("Chainlink", (0.42, 0.45, 0.46), 0.5, 0.9)

    box("Surround", (19.0, 37.0, 0.12), (0.0, 0.0, -0.06), m=surround)
    box("PlayArea", (13.0, 27.5, 0.02), (0.0, 0.0, 0.002), m=playarea)

    def line(name, x1, y1, x2, y2, lw=0.05):
        box(name, (max(abs(x2 - x1), lw), max(abs(y2 - y1), lw), 0.008),
            ((x1 + x2) / 2.0, (y1 + y2) / 2.0, 0.012), m=white)

    for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
        line("Baseline_%s" % s, -DOUB, s * HALF_L, DOUB, s * HALF_L, 0.10)
        line("ServiceLine_%s" % s, -SING, s * SERV, SING, s * SERV)
        line("CentreMark_%s" % s, 0.0, s * HALF_L, 0.0, s * (HALF_L - 0.10), 0.05)
        line("DoublesSide_%s" % s, s * DOUB, -HALF_L, s * DOUB, HALF_L)
        line("SinglesSide_%s" % s, s * SING, -HALF_L, s * SING, HALF_L)
    line("CentreService", 0.0, -SERV, 0.0, SERV)

    # --- net ---------------------------------------------------------------
    build_net(dark, white)
    box("CentreStrap", (0.05, 0.02, CENTRE_H), (0.0, 0.0, CENTRE_H / 2.0), m=white)
    for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
        cyl("NetPost_%s" % s, 0.055, 1.20, (s * NET_HALF, 0.0, 0.52), m=postm, verts=20)
        cyl("NetPostCap_%s" % s, 0.06, 0.03, (s * NET_HALF, 0.0, 1.13), m=postm, verts=20)

    # --- perimeter fence ---------------------------------------------------
    FX, FY, FH = 9.2, 18.0, 3.6
    step = 3.0
    n_side = int(round(2 * FY / step))
    n_end = int(round(2 * FX / step))
    for i in range(n_side + 1):
        y = -FY + 2 * FY * i / n_side
        for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
            cyl("FencePost", 0.05, FH, (s * FX, y, FH / 2.0 - 0.2), m=postm, verts=12)
    for i in range(1, n_end):
        x = -FX + 2 * FX * i / n_end
        for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
            cyl("FencePost", 0.05, FH, (x, s * FY, FH / 2.0 - 0.2), m=postm, verts=12)
    for s in (-1.0, 1.0):
        for z in (FH - 0.25, 1.6):
            tube("RailSide", (s * FX, -FY, z), (s * FX, FY, z), 0.035, m=postm, verts=10)
            tube("RailEnd", (-FX, s * FY, z), (FX, s * FY, z), 0.035, m=postm, verts=10)
        fence_panel("FenceSide_%s" % s, 2 * FY, FH - 0.05, 0.5,
                    (s * FX, 0.0, (FH - 0.05) / 2.0 - 0.2),
                    (math.pi / 2.0, 0.0, math.pi / 2.0), fencem)
        fence_panel("FenceEnd_%s" % s, 2 * FX, FH - 0.05, 0.5,
                    (0.0, s * FY, (FH - 0.05) / 2.0 - 0.2),
                    (math.pi / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0), fencem)

    # a couple of umpire-side details
    box("BenchSeat", (1.6, 0.45, 0.06), (7.8, -2.2, 0.45), m=postm, bevel=0.01)
    for bx in (7.1, 8.5):
        for by in (-2.4, -2.0):
            cyl("BenchLeg", 0.03, 0.42, (bx, by, 0.21), m=postm, verts=10)

    # --- lighting and camera ----------------------------------------------
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new("Sun", 'SUN')
    ld.energy = 4.5
    ld.angle = math.radians(1.5)
    sun = bpy.data.objects.new("Sun", ld)

    cam.location = (16.0, -22.0, 10.5)
    cam.rotation_euler = (Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.9)) - cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()

        ring2.append(bm.verts.new((r2 * math.cos(a), r2 * math.sin(a), z2)))
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        slot = (i // 2) % 2
        f = bm.faces.new((apex, ring1[i], ring1[j]))
        f.material_index = slot
        f = bm.faces.new((ring1[i], ring2[i], ring2[j], ring1[j]))
        f.material_index = slot
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces[:])
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()

    so = ob.modifiers.new("Solidify", 'SOLIDIFY')
    so.thickness = 0.012
    so.offset = 0.0
    smooth(ob, 55.0)
    return ob, R, rim_z, apex_z


def make_umbrella(idx, loc, rz, tilt, col_a, col_b, pole_m, rib_m):
    canopy, R, rim_z, apex_z = make_canopy(idx, col_a, col_b)
    parts = [canopy]
    parts.append(cyl("Pole_%d_low" % idx, 0.032, 1.30, (0.0, 0.0, 0.50), m=pole_m, verts=14))
    parts.append(cyl("Pole_%d_up" % idx, 0.026, 1.20, (0.0, 0.0, 1.55), m=pole_m, verts=14))
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.045, segments=16, ring_count=8,
                                         location=(0.0, 0.0, apex_z + 0.10))
    finial = bpy.context.object
    finial.name = "Finial_%d" % idx
    finial.data.materials.append(pole_m)
    smooth(finial)
    parts.append(finial)
    parts.append(cyl("Hub_%d" % idx, 0.05, 0.10, (0.0, 0.0, apex_z - 0.16), m=pole_m, verts=12))
    parts.append(cyl("Runner_%d" % idx, 0.045, 0.14, (0.0, 0.0, 1.42), m=pole_m, verts=12))
    for k in range(8):
        a = 2.0 * math.pi * k / 8.0
        p1 = (0.42 * R * math.cos(a) * 0.12, 0.42 * R * math.sin(a) * 0.12, apex_z - 0.14)
        p2 = (R * math.cos(a), R * math.sin(a), rim_z - 0.005)
        parts.append(tube("Rib_%d_%d" % (idx, k), p1, p2, 0.009, m=rib_m, verts=8))
        # stretcher from the runner out to mid rib
        mp = (0.55 * R * math.cos(a), 0.55 * R * math.sin(a), rim_z + 0.30)
        parts.append(tube("Stretcher_%d_%d" % (idx, k),
                          (0.05 * math.cos(a), 0.05 * math.sin(a), 1.45), mp,
                          0.007, m=rib_m, verts=6))
    return group(parts, "Umbrella_%d" % idx, loc, (tilt, 0.0, rz))


def make_chair(idx, loc, rz, frame_m, fabric_m, towel_m=None):
    parts = []
    p0 = (0.0, -0.72, 0.36)
    p1 = (0.0, 0.30, 0.38)
    p2 = (0.0, 0.66, 0.94)
    for sx in (-1.0, 1.0):
        x = sx * 0.32
        parts.append(tube("Rail_%d" % idx, (x, p0[1], p0[2]), (x, p1[1], p1[2]), 0.022, m=frame_m))
        parts.append(tube("Back_%d" % idx, (x, p1[1], p1[2]), (x, p2[1], p2[2]), 0.022, m=frame_m))
        parts.append(tube("LegF_%d" % idx, (x, -0.62, 0.37), (x, -0.72, 0.02), 0.02, m=frame_m))
        parts.append(tube("LegR_%d" % idx, (x, 0.26, 0.375), (x, 0.36, 0.02), 0.02, m=frame_m))
        parts.append(tube("ArmPost_%d" % idx, (x, -0.10, 0.37), (x, -0.10, 0.60), 0.018, m=frame_m))
        parts.append(tube("Arm_%d" % idx, (x, -0.30, 0.60), (x, 0.33, 0.66), 0.018, m=frame_m))
    parts.append(tube("CrossF_%d" % idx, (-0.32, -0.72, 0.03), (0.32, -0.72, 0.03), 0.018, m=frame_m))
    parts.append(tube("CrossR_%d" % idx, (-0.32, 0.36, 0.03), (0.32, 0.36, 0.03), 0.018, m=frame_m))
    parts.append(tube("TopBar_%d" % idx, (-0.32, 0.66, 0.94), (0.32, 0.66, 0.94), 0.022, m=frame_m))

    y = -0.66
    while y < 0.26:
        z = 0.36 + (y + 0.72) / 1.02 * 0.02 + 0.028
        parts.append(box("Slat_%d" % idx, (0.62, 0.075, 0.018), (0.0, y, z),
                         m=fabric_m, bevel=0.004))
        y += 0.113
    theta = math.atan2(0.56, 0.36)
    d = Vector((0.0, 0.36, 0.56)).normalized()
    nrm = Vector((0.0, -math.sin(theta), math.cos(theta)))
    base = Vector((0.0, 0.30, 0.38))
    t = 0.06
    while t < 0.64:
        c = base + d * t + nrm * 0.03
        parts.append(box("BackSlat_%d" % idx, (0.62, 0.075, 0.018), tuple(c),
                         rot=(theta, 0.0, 0.0), m=fabric_m, bevel=0.004))
        t += 0.113

    if towel_m is not None:
        parts.append(box("Towel_%d" % idx, (0.52, 0.80, 0.022), (0.02, -0.24, 0.42),
                         rot=(0.02, 0.0, 0.05), m=towel_m, bevel=0.008))
    return group(parts, "Chair_%d" % idx, loc, (0.0, 0.0, rz))

"""claude-075 - Rooftop HVAC unit with fan grilles, louvres and ductwork."""

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix


def reset():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'


def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (col[0], col[1], col[2], 1.0)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    return m


def smooth(ob, angle=40.0):
    for p in ob.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    es = ob.modifiers.new("EdgeSplit", 'EDGE_SPLIT')
    es.split_angle = math.radians(angle)


def box(name, dims, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, bevel=0.0):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=Vector(dims), verts=bm.verts)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if m:
        me.materials.append(m)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bv = ob.modifiers.new("Bevel", 'BEVEL')
        bv.width = bevel
        bv.segments = 2
        bv.limit_method = 'ANGLE'
    return ob


def cyl(name, r, h, loc, rot=(0, 0, 0), m=None, verts=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=r, depth=h,
                                        location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob = bpy.context.object
    ob.name = name
    if m:
        ob.data.materials.append(m)
    smooth(ob)
    return ob


def tube(name, p1, p2, r, m=None, verts=14):
    a, b = Vector(p1), Vector(p2)
    v = b - a
    ob = cyl(name, r, v.length, tuple((a + b) * 0.5), m=m, verts=verts)
    ob.rotation_euler = v.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return ob


def torus(name, major, minor, loc, m=None, mseg=48, nseg=8):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor,
                                     major_segments=mseg, minor_segments=nseg,
                                     location=loc)
    ob = bpy.context.object
    ob.name = name
    if m:
        ob.data.materials.append(m)
    smooth(ob)
    return ob


def fan_section(name, centre, cowl_r, steel, grille_m, blade_m):
    cx, cy, cz = centre
    cyl(name + "_Cowl", cowl_r, 0.22, (cx, cy, cz + 0.11), m=steel, verts=40)
    cyl(name + "_Throat", cowl_r - 0.05, 0.24, (cx, cy, cz + 0.05), m=steel, verts=40)
    top = cz + 0.22

    for r in (cowl_r * 0.36, cowl_r * 0.62, cowl_r * 0.90):
        torus(name + "_Ring", r, 0.010, (cx, cy, top), m=grille_m, mseg=40, nseg=6)
    torus(name + "_Rim", cowl_r + 0.02, 0.022, (cx, cy, top - 0.01), m=steel, mseg=44, nseg=8)
    for k in range(10):
        a = math.pi * k / 10.0
        box(name + "_Spoke", (0.018, 2.0 * cowl_r * 0.94, 0.014),
            (cx, cy, top), rot=(0.0, 0.0, a), m=grille_m)
    cyl(name + "_GrilleHub", 0.075, 0.05, (cx, cy, top + 0.01), m=grille_m, verts=16)

    # fan and motor below the grille
    cyl(name + "_Hub", 0.10, 0.16, (cx, cy, cz - 0.02), m=steel, verts=20)
    for k in range(6):
        a = 2.0 * math.pi * k / 6.0
        blade = box(name + "_Blade", (cowl_r * 0.72, 0.14, 0.010), m=blade_m)
        blade.matrix_world = (Matrix.Translation((cx, cy, cz - 0.02)) @
                              Matrix.Rotation(a, 4, 'Z') @
                              Matrix.Translation((cowl_r * 0.46, 0.0, 0.0)) @
                              Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(26.0), 4, 'X'))


def louvre_panel(name, centre, width, rows, steel, louvre_m, face_y):
    cx, cy, cz = centre
    box(name + "_Frame", (width + 0.10, 0.05, rows * 0.095 + 0.10),
        (cx, cy, cz), m=steel, bevel=0.006)
    for i in range(rows):
        z = cz - rows * 0.095 / 2.0 + 0.05 + i * 0.095
        box(name + "_Slat", (width, 0.085, 0.016),
            (cx, cy + face_y * 0.03, z),
            rot=(math.radians(32.0) * face_y, 0.0, 0.0), m=louvre_m)


def duct_run(name, y, steel):
    """Horizontal run out of the +X end, square mitred elbow, drop to the roof."""
    w, h = 0.70, 0.55
    z = 1.05
    x0, x1 = 1.55, 3.85
    box(name + "_Horiz", (x1 - x0, w, h), ((x0 + x1) / 2.0, y, z), m=steel, bevel=0.01)
    box(name + "_Elbow", (h, w, h), (x1 + h / 2.0, y, z), m=steel, bevel=0.01)
    box(name + "_Drop", (h, w, z - h / 2.0 - 0.0),
        (x1 + h / 2.0, y, (z - h / 2.0) / 2.0), m=steel, bevel=0.01)
    # flanged joints
    for fx in (x0 + 0.05, x0 + 0.85, x0 + 1.65, x1 - 0.02):
        box(name + "_Flange", (0.03, w + 0.07, h + 0.07), (fx, y, z), m=steel)
    for fz in (0.75, 0.30):
        box(name + "_DropFlange", (h + 0.07, w + 0.07, 0.03),
            (x1 + h / 2.0, y, fz), m=steel)
    # roof curb and support stand
    box(name + "_Curb", (h + 0.30, w + 0.30, 0.22), (x1 + h / 2.0, y, 0.11),
        m=steel, bevel=0.01)
    for sx in (x0 + 0.7, x0 + 1.7):
        box(name + "_StandPad", (0.22, 0.30, 0.06), (sx, y, 0.03), m=steel)
        box(name + "_StandPost", (0.07, 0.07, z - h / 2.0),
            (sx, y, (z - h / 2.0) / 2.0), m=steel)
        box(name + "_StandCap", (0.20, w + 0.06, 0.05),
            (sx, y, z - h / 2.0 - 0.025), m=steel)
